lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns; specifically, a central column of three distinct nodes is visible posterior to the pectoral fin, flanked by less defined clusters forming a loose grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, most prominent in the mid-lateral section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow-induced lower intensity on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent semi-circular notch missing from the trailing (posterior) edge of the left pectoral fin, indicating significant healed tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora attached to the ventral region near the pectoral fin base and small yellow-pigmented fish near the anterior rostrum.
